name: dsh-desktop
description: DSH Desktop — Tauri shell + bundled Node sidecar for the dsh web profile

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && tauri build
scripts.build:macos: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:macos:arm64: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:macos:x64: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:windows: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.dmg:x64: pnpm tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p release && cp "src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/DSH Desktop_$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")_x64.dmg" release/
